from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- shank (turned, tapered) ---
shank_length = 60.0          # length of the tapered shank
shank_dia_root = 8.3         # diameter at the large (head) end
shank_dia_tip = 5.0          # diameter at the small (tip) end

# --- head ---
head_length = 15.0           # axial length of the head
head_dia = 16.6              # head diameter
head_fillet = 1.5            # fillet radius at the shank / head junction

# --- tip ---
tip_length = 5.0             # length of the small tip boss
tip_dia = 2.8                # tip boss diameter
tip_chamfer = 0.3            # chamfer on the tip end face

# --- hex socket (in the head end face) ---
hex_flat_distance = 9.0      # across-flats size of the hex socket
hex_depth = 10.0             # depth of the hex socket

# --- transverse set-screw hole (through the head) ---
set_screw_dia = 3.0          # diameter of the set-screw hole
set_screw_offset = 5.0       # offset of the hole axis from the head centreline

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- tapered shank (axis along +Y) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (shank_dia_root / 2, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (shank_dia_tip / 2, shank_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0, shank_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    # ---- head (cylinder, axis along +Y) ----
    with Locations((0, shank_length + head_length / 2, 0)):
        Cylinder(head_dia / 2, head_length, rotation=(90, 0, 0))

    # ---- fillet the shank / head junction ----
    junction_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Y - shank_length) < 0.5
        and abs(e.center().X) < 1e-6
        and abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6
    ]
    fillet(junction_edges, head_fillet)

    # ---- small tip boss at the free end ----
    with Locations((0, -tip_length / 2, 0)):
        Cylinder(tip_dia / 2, tip_length, rotation=(90, 0, 0))

    # ---- chamfer the tip end face ----
    tip_face = p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
    chamfer(tip_face.edges(), tip_chamfer)

    # ---- hex socket in the head end face ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(shank_length + head_length)) as hs:
        RegularPolygon(hex_flat_distance, 6)
    extrude(amount=-hex_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- transverse set-screw hole through the head ----
    with Locations((0, shank_length + head_length / 2, set_screw_offset)):
        Cylinder(set_screw_dia / 2, head_dia + 2, rotation=(0, 90, 0),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
shaft_diameter = 8.3          # round shaft
shaft_radius = shaft_diameter / 2.0
shaft_length = 60.0

head_diameter = 16.6          # hexagonal head across the flats
head_radius = head_diameter / 2.0
head_length = 15.0            # axial height of the head
fillet_radius = 1.3           # generous fillet at the shaft / head shoulder

slot_width = 3.0              # hexagonal socket in the head face
slot_depth = 10.0             # depth of the socket
socket_center_y = 37.5        # socket located on the upper side of the head

tip_chamfer = 0.3             # small chamfer on the shaft tip
tip_ridge_height = 0.7        # small ridge on the shaft tip
tip_ridge_diameter = 2.8      # ridge diameter
ridge_center_y = -30.35

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- revolved profile: shaft + hexagonal head ---------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0.0, 0.0),
                (shaft_radius, 0.0),
                (shaft_radius, shaft_length - fillet_radius),
                (head_radius, shaft_length),
                (head_radius, shaft_length + head_length),
                (0.0, shaft_length + head_length),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    # --- generous fillet at the shaft / head shoulder -----------------------
    shoulder_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Y - shaft_length) < 0.5
        and abs(e.radius - head_radius) < 0.5
    ]
    fillet(shoulder_edges, radius=fillet_radius)

    # --- hexagonal socket cut into the head face ----------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(shaft_length + head_length)):
        with Locations((socket_center_y, 0.0)):
            RegularPolygon(slot_width, 6)
    extrude(amount=-slot_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- small ridge on the shaft tip ---------------------------------------
    with Locations((0.0, ridge_center_y, 0.0)):
        Cylinder(
            radius=tip_ridge_diameter / 2.0,
            height=tip_ridge_height,
            rotation=(90.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        )

    # --- small chamfer on the shaft tip edge --------------------------------
    tip_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if e.center().Y < -29.0
        and e.center().Y > -31.5
        and e.radius < 1.5
    ]
    chamfer(tip_edges, length=tip_chamfer)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - straight shank, flared head, side slot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
shank_dia        = 8.3      # straight shank diameter
shank_len        = 60.0     # straight shank length
head_len         = 20.0     # flared head length
head_dia         = 16.6     # flared head diameter

slot_width       = 6.0      # side slot width

knurl_pitch      = 4.0      # knurl band spacing

knurl_len        = 10.0     # knurl band length
knurl_height     = 0.9      # knurl ridge height
knurl_root_dia   = 6.0      # knurl band root diameter

head_radius = head_dia / 2.0
shank_radius = shank_dia / 2.0
head_start = shank_len
head_end = shank_len + head_len

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Turned shank + flared head profile (revolved about the axis)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0.0, 0.0),
                (0.0, shank_len),
                (shank_radius, shank_len),
                (shank_radius, head_start + head_taper_len),
                (head_radius, head_start + head_taper_len),
                (head_radius, head_end),
                (0.0, head_end),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid = p.part

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Knurled grip band (raised circumferential ridges)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as kp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0.0, knurl_start),
                (knurl_root_dia / 2.0, knurl_start),
                (knurl_root_dia / 2.0, knurl_start + knurl_len),
                (0.0, knurl_start + knurl_len),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

knurl_solid = kp.part
n_bands = int((shank_len - knurl_start) // knurl_pitch)
for i in range(n_bands):
    solid = solid + Pos(0, i * knurl_pitch, 0) * knurl_solid

# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
slot = Pos(0, head_start + head_end) * Box(
    2.0 * head_radius + 0.2,   # wide enough to clear the curved head
    slot_len,
    slot_depth,
)
solid = solid - slot

# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------

solid = chamfer(rim_edges, chamfer_size)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - single tapered-pin rivet, revolved about the
# longitudinal axis, plus a rectangular through-slot in the head.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
pin_length = 60.0          # overall length, tip (Y=0) to head face (Y=60)
pin_dia = 8.3             # shank diameter
pin_radius = pin_dia / 2.0
head_dia = 16.6           # head diameter
head_radius = head_dia / 2.0
head_length = 15.0        # cylindrical head length
shank_length = pin_length - head_length   # 45.0
shank_taper = 0.4         # radial taper of the shank (larger at head end)
tip_radius = pin_radius - shank_taper     # 3.75 at the tip
tip_chamfer = 0.8         # chamfer at the pin tip

slot_width = 6.5          # slot width across the head
slot_depth = 12.0         # slot depth measured in from the head face
slot_length = 30.0        # slot length along the axis

boss_radius = 1.4         # small raised boss at the tip face
boss_height = 5.0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as rivet:
    # --- revolved outer profile of the pin -----------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as profile:
        with BuildLine() as pl:
            l1 = Line((0.0, 0.0), (tip_radius, 0.0))                       # tip face
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (pin_radius, shank_length))                 # shank taper
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (head_radius, shank_length))                # shoulder
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (head_radius, pin_length))                  # head OD
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0.0, pin_length))                          # head face
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0.0, 0.0))                                 # close on axis
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    # --- rectangular through-slot cut into the head OD -----------
    with Locations((0.0, pin_length - slot_depth / 2.0, 0.0)):
        Box(slot_length, slot_depth, slot_width, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- small raised boss on the tip face -----------------------
    with Locations((0.0, -boss_height / 2.0, 0.0)):
        Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)

    # --- chamfer the tip edge ------------------------------------
    tip_edges = rivet.edges().group_by(Axis.Y)[0]
    chamfer(tip_edges, tip_chamfer)

# Main elbow: sweep of rectangular pipe profile along 90 deg arc
with BuildPart() as elbow:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        Rectangle(pipe_radius * 2, pipe_od)
    with BuildLine() as path:
        ThreePointArc(
            (centerline_radius, 0, 0),
            (centerline_radius, centerline_radius, 0),
            (0, centerline_radius, 0)
        )
    sweep(sections=profile.sketch, path=path.wire())

solid_body = elbow.part

# Fillet the inner corner edge (the edge at the origin)
inner_edge = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.X)[:1]
solid_body = fillet(inner_edge, fillet_radius)

# Hollow out the elbow to create the pipe wall

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        Rectangle(pipe_id / 2, pipe_id)
    with BuildLine() as path:
        ThreePointArc(
            (centerline_radius, 0, 0),
            (centerline_radius, centerline_radius, 0),
            (0, centerline_radius, 0)
        )
    sweep(sections=profile.sketch, path=path.wire())

    (0, hole_offset, hole_spacing / 2),
    (0, hole_offset, -hole_spacing / 2),
]

    )

]

    )
